svg.title: Time to answer 1, 10 or 50 questions about one document
svg.desc: Median seconds for each system, for documents of 3,000 and 6,000 tokens, on a log axis; the table in the report has every value.
svg.text: Time to answer 1, 10 or 50 questions about one document
Median seconds over 5 to 10 documents per point; log scale. One RTX PRO 6000 at 600 W, AMD EPYC 9534, each system on its own server.
One request: document read once for all questions
One request: document read again for every question
One request per question: document shared by the prefix cache

svg.text: A dot is the median wall time to answer every question about one document: one request that carries them, or the requests in a row for the systems that take one question each.
Quyet-1.0-Large was stopped at a 900 s cap after its 3,000-token cells; its 6,000-token cells were not reached. decisio runs in its served default mode.
Torchcast reads a shared beginning of 4,096 tokens or more once per request, so at 6,000 tokens it does not re-read the whole document.
